meanings.morph: attributive; feminine nom./acc. singular, plural without article, or after der/die/das

sentences.en: She's the love of my life.

sentences.text: Das große Haus gehört meinem Vater.
sentences.en: The big house belongs to my father.

sentences.text: Die große Stadt macht mir Angst.
Warum hast du so große Augen?
sentences.en: Why do you have such big eyes?

sentences.text: Eine große Stadt wie Berlin ist nichts für mich.
sentences.en: A big city like Berlin isn't for me.

meanings.notes: REVIEW warning: The morph 'or after der/die/das' is misleading: after plural 'die' the form is 'großen' (die großen Städte), and after 'der' only the nominative masculine takes -e. Suggest 'singular after der (nom.), die/das (nom./acc.)'.
